teach.description: Your courses, your grading queue, your deadlines.
teach.noCoursesText: Courses are created by the academy administrator and assigned to you. Once one is assigned, it appears here.

student.description: What's due, what's been graded, what you're enrolled in.
student.nothingDueText: Assignments and exams with deadlines appear here once your courses are published.
student.noGradesText: When an instructor grades your work and releases it, it shows up here.

landing.heading: One place for every course, exam and grade.
landing.subheading: Instructors teach. Students learn. You keep the whole academy in view.
landing.signInCta: Sign in to Golden Edu Hub
landing.featureCoursesText: Modules, lessons, PDFs, links and images — no video hosting needed.
landing.featureAssessmentText: Auto-graded objective questions, a manual queue for written answers, and server-enforced timers.
landing.featureControlText: Every course, every grade, every override — audited and traceable.
landing.footerNote: Accounts are created by the academy administrator.
